newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Shipping - Grain/oilseed cargoes - Jan 23.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Shipping - Grain/oilseed cargoes - Jan 23.

text.p: The following is the berthing schedule for major dry bulk vessels unloading at Taiwan's main grain ports at Taichung and Kaohsiung, as detailed on Thursday by Taiwan surveyors.
The discharging cargoes are given in tonnes. Berthing dates are for arrival in port/expected completion of discharge.
Commodity Tonnes Vessel Buyer Berthing
At Kaohsiung:
Corn 44,934 M Nuri Cerrahcglu Mitsui Jan 23/27
Soybean 55,068 Sam John Capain BSPA - K Jan 15/24
At Taichung:
Soybean 54,249 Ocean Jade BSPA -T Jan 23/28
Corn/soybean 59,113 Full Beauty CK Group Jan 25/30
Incoming Taiwan grain/oilseed shipments in tonnes with scheduled dates of arrival. K is Kaohsiung; T is Taichung.
Taiwan also has bulk offloading facilities at Keelung.
